entries.text: Thank you for calling VeloFit customer support. Your call may be recorded for quality assurance. Please wait while we connect you to the next available agent.
Thank you for holding. My name is David. How can I help you today?
Yeah, David, I want to return this garbage jersey I bought from you. It's completely the wrong size and I'm not paying for something I can't even wear.
I'm very sorry to hear that you're unhappy with the fit. I can certainly look into the return options for you. Do you have your order number handy?
It's about time someone helped. The order is VF95112. This ProFit jersey is advertised for performance, but it's so ridiculously too tight I can barely breathe. Your sizing charts are a complete lie!
I understand your frustration. One moment while I pull up that order... Okay, I see the ProFit Jersey, delivered on December 28th. I just need to check our return policy for that item.

Don't you dare give me some runaround about a policy. I want my money back. I'm a signature-level member and I'll be leaving reviews everywhere and talking to your manager if this isn't handled right now.

There's no need for that, sir. I've just confirmed, and you're well within the 90-day return window for this item. I can process this for you immediately. Would you prefer a refund, or would you like to do an exchange for a larger size?
An exchange? Seriously? Why would I want another one? Just give me my money back. I'm done with this.

A refund it is. I have just initiated that return in our system. You will receive an email shortly with a pre-paid shipping label. Simply pack the jersey, attach the label, and drop it at any post office. Once our warehouse receives it, the refund will be credited back to your original payment method.
Fine. It better be that simple. This whole experience has been a waste of my time.
I do apologize again for the trouble with the sizing. I've made a note of your feedback about the jersey being too tight for our product team. Is there anything else I can assist you with today?
No. Just make sure I get my refund.
It's all in process, sir. Thank you for calling VeloFit, and have a good day.
